Warehousing

ऑर्डर सटीकता

A key warehouse performance metric measuring the percentage of orders picked, packed, and shipped without errors, as reported in audit trails, shipping manifests, and WMS/ERP dashboards.

Quick answer: A key warehouse performance metric measuring the percentage of orders picked, packed, and shipped without errors, as reported in audit trails, shipping manifests, and WMS/ERP dashboards.

Why it matters

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is ऑर्डर सटीकता?

In this glossary, ऑर्डर सटीकता refers to: A key warehouse performance metric measuring the percentage of orders picked, packed, and shipped without errors, as reported in audit trails, shipping manifests, and WMS/ERP dashboards.

How is ऑर्डर सटीकता used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "ऑर्डर सटीकता को उच्च बनाए रखना ग्राहक अपेक्षाओं को पूरा करने और वेयरहाउस संचालन में महंगे रिटर्न या दावे को कम करने के लिए आवश्यक है।"

Why does ऑर्डर सटीकता matter in logistics?

ऑर्डर सटीकता matters because it supports clear communication in Warehousing contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses ऑर्डर सटीकता?

ऑर्डर सटीकता is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does ऑर्डर सटीकता belong to?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A key warehouse performance metric measuring the percentage of orders picked, packed, and shipped without errors, as reported in audit trails, shipping manifests, and WMS/ERP dashboards.

Operational example

Maintaining high order accuracy is essential to meeting customer expectations and reducing costly returns or claims in warehousing operations.
